name: Darwinbox
tagline: We enable rapidly growing companies & large enterprises with AI-powered HCM for the evolving world of work!
description:
Darwinbox is a new-age, agile HCM Suite that enables enterprises and growing businesses to automate their day-to-day HR processes, deliver actionable insights and build better workplaces. Powered by Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML), Darwinbox provides a lightweight and easy to use mobile-first experience to the last mile employee.
 
🌍 Today we serve over 1000 organizations and 4M employees across 130+ countries including large conglomerates and fast-growing tech companies like Adani, Kopi Kenangan, MatchMove, Starbucks, Apollo.io, Mahindra, Bank BTPN, TVS, Shakey’s, Pouring With Heart, JSW, Ephicacy, Nivea, Swiggy, Tokopedia, JG Summit Group, NutriAsia, Indorama and more.
🏆 We have been recognized for the 4th consecutive year on the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, globally.
🚀 We have been recognized as a "Strong Performer" on the Forrester® HCM Wave™ 2023.
💼 We have partnered with Microsoft with the focus on co-innovating and delivering solutions to enhance employee experience and organizational agility.
⭐️ We are the best-rated solution by customers on Gartner’s Peer Insights platform with an average rating of 4.7.
